note: One entry per button of the customer GUI. GUI entry and headless entry call the SAME customer scripts in vendor\2210_trace32 (never modified); only the source of the parameters differs (a dialog box vs the command line). Bypassed on purpose: the GUI wrapper itself (27x DIALOG.* + STOP) and select_thread.cmm (interactive picker). Safe=false means: measured to spin forever on THIS arena, so 'all' skips it unless you ask for it by name.

functions.name: load
functions.desc: load the ramdump bins + elf, then report SYSINFO / ERRINFO; the GUI keeps both in dyntext, so they never reach its file

functions.name: show_thread
functions.desc: thread table: name / priority / state / stack / mailbox counters

functions.name: backtrace
functions.desc: backtrace from exc_trace (the exception frame) and decode that register frame

functions.name: thread_bt
functions.desc: backtrace ONE chosen thread; the name comes from -Thread <name> (default idle, the GUI's own default)
body: PRINT "THREADBT: no thread matched - see the THREADPICK list above"

functions.name: all_thread_bt
functions.desc: backtrace every thread in g_osThreadList, using the customer's own traversal

functions.name: mailbox
functions.desc: mailbox / message queue contents. The button is labelled MSG Box but the script behind it is show_mailbox.cmm.

functions.name: mem_trace
functions.unsafe_reason: show_ap_meminfo.cmm calls print_dlmalloc_heap.cmm, whose free-list walk has no cycle guard; measured to spin with zero output on this arena. Use the 'heap' function instead.
functions.desc: per-heap detail for the AP heaps (system mem / share buf / up node / modem share buf). Unbounded walker - see unsafe_reason.

functions.name: mem_summary
functions.unsafe_reason: show_ap_meminfo_sum.cmm calls print_mem_summary_by_file.cmm, whose chunk loop has no size==0 guard; measured to spin with zero output on this arena. Use the 'heap' function instead.
functions.desc: heap summary by file. Unbounded walker - see unsafe_reason.

functions.name: thread_swap
functions.desc: thread/IRQ swap arrays; the lowest-yield script of the set - it prints only a few raw addresses on this scene

functions.name: heap
functions.desc: the dlmalloc arena descriptor, read with the idioms that do evaluate here; the chunk chain is recomputed offline

functions.name: sysinfo
functions.desc: current thread + interrupt nesting, as text

functions.name: errinfo
functions.desc: the fault itself: assert (core/file/line/pc) or exception (mcause/mdcause/mepc/mtval) decoded

functions.name: heap_offline
functions.button: (no button - not possible in the GUI at all)
functions.desc: the same heap, computed from the raw dump bytes by Python - no TRACE32, no licence, no GUI
